items.incumbent: Road (b) of record: cycle-averaged functional with frozen-time per-phase decomposition for BOTH the design loop and the evaluation of the two TWIN arms (TWIN protocol §4: both arms evaluated on the same mu with the per-phase engine), the O(St) first-order corrector as the unsteadiness bar (D1 §8, M0 VI.4bis(ii), S-P4F SCHEMA, G3 threshold never derived), the wave-frame implicit BVP / B-lite marching as BACKSTOP only ([S-BLITE] M0 :3027-3044; C51 NEVER), the certificate-first constitution (declared axiology, ledger C57 note), the decisive experiment = truncated-plug head-to-head at ~1% Isp on class-A data.
items.alternative: The HYBRID ranked first by all four de-novo lenses (stageA_tree_variational.md S0.4; stageA_tree_optimization.md S7; stageA_tree_propulsion.md H-1; stageA_tree_hyperbolic.md S11): design loop = cycle-weighted frozen-time multipoint axisymmetric engine with a discrete adjoint (the incumbent's engine); EVALUATION of every competing design (both arms, the tuned classical comparator, the bound/ceiling arm) on an exact rotating-frame steady 3-D evaluator (time-independence of the axisymmetric-surface thrust under the single-mode pin = the record's [T-T0]); a bracket/ceiling SCREEN first (ideal isentropic bound / Jensen screen / interface characteristic-count audit: if the tuned classical design already sits within the band of the ceiling, the answer to Q0 is NEGATIVE before any optimizer runs); the reduction loss MEASURED by an Omega-sweep, not assumed; the St obligation moved from the evaluation to the DESIGNER only (argmax shift = [T-RED]/OPTSHIFT object, a CLAIM with falsifier).
items.advocate_persona: the union of the four derivers (variational + hyperbolic + optimization + propulsion lenses): argue the HYBRID at its genuine best, price the 3-D rotating-frame evaluator honestly against the statement budget (7-10 sessions, workstation, no GPU) and against the record's own B-lite marching cost claim, and state the falsifier 'which measurement would make the program change road'
items.refuter_persona: the program's own constitution defender AND the JPP referee at once: attack the hybrid's cost (a 3-D steady rotating-frame Euler evaluator with certified error bars inside the budget), its dependence on the single-mode pin, the unproven claim that the per-phase argmax shift is band-negligible, and ALSO attack the incumbent where it is weaker (no J_1 corrector exists; St_n up to 1.41 on the plug; the certification frontier is version-bound)
